summary: Completed comprehensive testing of legacy WordPress plugin migration to FastAPI. All 30 backend tests passed (100%). All frontend flows working correctly. Key features verified: server-side pricing computation, tracking enrichment with user_agent/ip, legacy-compatible response format (inserted_id, price, base_price, range_price, discount_price), HubSpot/webhook disabled returns sent=false, UTM/gclid preservation in redirects.

BACKEND: GET /api/leads returns leads with 'tracking' field (not just 'utm') - PASSED
BACKEND: HubSpot and webhook return sent=false when disabled (ENABLE_HUBSPOT=false, ENABLE_WEBHOOK=false) - PASSED
BACKEND: Pricing range logic: range 3000-5000 has -20% discount - VERIFIED

seed_data_creation: Test leads created during testing with various tracking data (gclid, utm_source, utm_medium). Backend auto-seeds 6 default price ranges on startup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Legacy migration testing complete. Key verified features: 1) Server computes final price during saveLead (not frontend), 2) Response includes inserted_id + price + base_price + range_price + discount_price, 3) Tracking field added to lead model (replaces simple utm field), enriched with server-side user_agent/ip, 4) HubSpot/webhook return sent=false when disabled, 5) Pricing ranges: 0-3000(-25%), 3000-5000(-20%), 5000-10000(-15%), 10000-20000(-12%), 20000-50000(-10%), 50000-200000(-8%). Mock plates: AA123BB (Peugeot 208), CC456DD (Renault Clio V). Backend URL: https://car-buyback-1.preview.emergentagent.com

mocked_apis.autobiz_service.py: Vehicle identification and quotation fully mocked - returns predefined vehicles for known plates, random vehicles for unknown plates
